Our Story

Rooted in Tradition,
Served with Devotion

Srikrishna Bhavan was born out of a deep love for South India's timeless culinary heritage. Our kitchen follows age-old recipes — stone-ground batters, hand-blended spice mixes, and the freshest ingredients — because authentic taste begins long before the first flame is lit.

Every plate carries the warmth of a grandmother's kitchen in Chennai or Udupi: familiar, honest, and deeply satisfying.

🌿 Pure Vegetarian 🏺 Traditional Recipes 🥛 Fresh Ingredients 🪔 No Artificial Flavours
🫓
Stone-Ground Dosa Batter

Fermented overnight the traditional way — crispy, flavourful, and authentic.

☕
Authentic Filter Coffee

Brewed from dark-roasted Coorg beans using our heritage brass filter, frothed to perfection.

🍱
Buffet & Tiffin Specials

Weekend breakfast, lunch buffets, Thursday Dosa Night, and daily fresh tiffins.
